questions.question: "I am happy," she said. → She said that she ___ happy.
questions.explanation: ย้อนกาล am เป็น was

questions.question: He said, "I like pizza." → He said that he ___ pizza.
questions.explanation: ย้อนกาลปัจจุบันเป็นอดีต

questions.question: She ___ me that she was tired.
questions.explanation: told ตามด้วยกรรม ส่วน said ไม่ตามด้วยกรรม

questions.question: "I will help you," he said. → He said he ___ help me.
questions.explanation: will เปลี่ยนเป็น would

questions.question: "Where do you live?" he asked me. → He asked me where I ___.
questions.explanation: คำถามเปลี่ยนเป็นประโยคบอกเล่าและย้อนกาล

questions.question: "Are you tired?" she asked. → She asked ___ I was tired.
questions.explanation: คำถาม yes/no ใช้ if หรือ whether

questions.question: "I have finished my work," she said. → She said she ___ her work.
questions.explanation: present perfect เปลี่ยนเป็น past perfect

questions.question: "Don't be late," the teacher said. → The teacher told us ___ late.
questions.explanation: คำสั่งปฏิเสธใช้ not to + V1
